themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe continue to advocate for policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants, particularly in areas like housing, social benefits, and employment. This theme is evident in Spain, Italy, Norway, France, and the UK, with parties like Vox, Lega, Fremskrittspartiet, Rassemblement National, and Reform UK leading the charge.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands priority for Spaniards in social housing and criticizes immigrant rights policies in regional governments.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega pushes for 'national priority' in employment and social services, particularly in coalition agreements with Fratelli d'Italia.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Advocates for redirecting funds from international aid to domestic services, emphasizing national priorities.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Proposes policies to prioritize French citizens in welfare and employment, opposing EU migration pacts.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Calls for stricter immigration controls and prioritizing British citizens in social benefits and housing.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentina's President Javier Milei faces declining approval ratings and internal conflicts within his party, La Libertad Avanza. His confrontational style and policy disputes with allies like Patricia Bullrich and Karina Milei are central to this narrative, which resonates in Argentina, Spain, the US, Italy, and Poland.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's approval ratings decline due to internal disputes and policy failures, particularly with allies like Bullrich.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes Milei's leadership and internal conflicts, framing it as a cautionary tale for right-wing movements.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Compares Milei's struggles to Trump's political challenges, emphasizing the risks of internal divisions.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Highlights Milei's declining popularity as a warning for right-wing leaders in Europe.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Uses Milei's struggles to critique opposition strategies and internal party dynamics.

themes.title: Far-right gains in European local elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties are making significant gains in local and regional elections across Europe, particularly in Germany, Italy, Spain, Sweden, and the UK. These gains reflect broader trends of rising far-right influence in national politics.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, signaling strong local election performance.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega and Fratelli d'Italia make gains in local elections, particularly in coalition governments.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Gains influence in regional governments through coalition agreements with PP, particularly in Andalusia and Castilla y León.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Increases its share of local government seats, particularly in coalition with center-right parties.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Wins by-elections and gains council seats, challenging traditional parties in local elections.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are experiencing internal divisions, with leadership struggles, defections, and ideological conflicts. This theme is evident in Poland, Hungary, the UK, France, Italy, and Argentina.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Faces internal conflicts over leadership and policy direction, particularly between Kaczyński and Nawrocki.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK

themes.title: Far-right reactions to Middle East conflicts
themes.blurb: Far-right parties and leaders are increasingly framing their responses to Middle East conflicts through the lens of immigration, national security, and cultural identity. This theme is evident in the US, Argentina, Italy, Poland, and France, where far-right figures are leveraging these conflicts to push anti-immigration and nationalist agendas.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration frames Middle East conflicts as a justification for stricter immigration policies and military interventions.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's government aligns with pro-Israel policies, using Middle East conflicts to justify anti-immigration rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government supports Israel and frames Middle East conflicts as a threat to European security and identity.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Criticizes Ukraine's stance on historical conflicts, using Middle East tensions to justify nationalist policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Opposes immigration from Middle Eastern countries, framing conflicts as a threat to French identity.
